ability.infinity.power_stone.sky_fist.de: Left (aim, up to 48 blocks): a giant purple magic circle forms and spins in the sky, the sky darkens and a colossal runed arm (fist 10 to 20 blocks wide, by size) pushes out of the circle slowly and then plunges, fingers clenching, slamming the spot: a shockwave sized to the fist, dust, flying rocks and camera shake. The arm lingers half a second and climbs back up, and the circle closes. Weak damage (about 7% of max HP, 3-4 block radius) and knockback. The ground is dented by a crater that restores itself in about 10 s. Right: open-palm slam, knockback only, no damage. Scroll: fist size 1-3.
ability.infinity.power_stone.creator_han: Complete gauntlet. Left (aim): a colossal golden gauntlet (16 to 24 blocks) descends through the clouds out of a golden six-stone circle on the aimed living being (player or any creature, bosses included) or, aiming at the ground, on everyone around. Middle click: list of the players in the dimension; the chosen one is grabbed from any distance. Whoever is grabbed is locked in a camera cutscene and cannot press any key. Holding hurts nobody. While the fist is closed: Scroll changes the force 1-10 live; Left = SQUEEZE (one hard squeeze takes 2% to 25% of max health by force, ignoring armour; holding the button keeps squeezing at that share per second); at force 10 the squeeze EXECUTES: everything in the hand bursts into pieces. Right = RELEASE (the hand opens and everyone floats down slowly). You stay still while holding, but can look around. Everyone is released if you leave the game, die, change dimension or drop the gauntlet.
